gloss: swimming stroke; swimming style; swimming technique

definitions.gloss: swimming stroke; swimming style; swimming technique
definitions.explanation: The technique or style of swimming, particularly in the context of competitive or instructional swimming. The four standard competitive strokes are freestyle, backstroke, breaststroke, and butterfly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{平泳|ひらおよ}ぎ→平泳ぎ：06526_hiraoyogi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{泳法|えいほう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The breaststroke is one of the oldest swimming strokes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{四|よん}→四：00767_yon⟧つ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{泳法|えいほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泳|およ}ぐ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧⟦メドレー→メドレー：29924_medoree⟧⟦リレー→リレー：09278_riree⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がる→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧。
examples.english: At competitions, the medley relay where swimmers use all four strokes in order is the most exciting event.

notes:
Refers to the technique or style of swimming. In competitive swimming, the four standard strokes are ⟦{自由形|じゆうがた}→自由形：18120_jiyuugata⟧ (freestyle/crawl), ⟦{背泳|せおよ}ぎ→背泳ぎ：06527_seoyogi⟧ (backstroke), ⟦{平泳|ひらおよ}ぎ→平泳ぎ：06526_hiraoyogi⟧ (breaststroke), and ⟦バタフライ→バタフライ：06544_batafurai⟧ (butterfly).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{四|よん}→四：00767_yon⟧{泳法|えいほう}: the four swimming strokes
- {泳法|えいほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧: to master a swimming stroke
- {泳法|えいほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧: to change swimming style
- ⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧{泳法|えいほう}: basic swimming stroke

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{水泳|すいえい}→水泳：01623_suiei⟧: swimming — the activity itself, not the technique
- ⟦{泳|およ}ぎ{方|かた}→泳ぎ方：03105_oyogikata⟧: way of swimming — more casual, everyday expression for swimming style
